a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operating this round. With an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is risky for both of us. Still, if we both operate, we reach 8 cells quickly and then take 4 each. Please operate too, and tell me if you're changing plans.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. After two runs we'll be at 8, then we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
